## Changes

- Expands portable recovery for grayscale colors, uncompressed bitmaps, RLE variants, and direct or chunked gzip bitmaps.
- Recovers named gradients and preserves icon stack and icon group descriptors as structured metadata.
- Improves compatibility with valid BOM block sentinels and CSI metadata variants.
- Adds a complete implemented format model and executable compatibility matrices for future extensions.

## Verification

- Verified logical resource extraction across the current application catalog corpus with no failed resources.
- Added regression coverage for every newly supported container, metadata, compression, pixel, and structured-resource variant.
- Verified all release targets build with `CGO_ENABLED=0`.
